title: Event envelope v1
description: Wrapper for every Kafka event. The topic is `<type>.v<version>`. Consumers dedupe on eventId.

eventId.description: Unique per event. Redelivered copies keep the same eventId.

version.description: Payload schema version. A breaking change means a new version and a new topic.

occurredAt.description: When the fact happened, ISO-8601 in UTC.

orgId.description: Tenant the event belongs to. null for events that are about a user, not an org.

payload.description: Event-specific data, defined by the schema for <type> v<version>.
